items.title: AMD sinks on revenue forecasts as competition with Nvidia grows more apparent
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock pulls back on Wednesday since the chipmaking giant topped second quarter earnings estimates alongside increased capex spending that may have shocked investors. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to react to AMD's projections and its growing competition with Nvidia (NVDA).

items.title: SpaceX teams up with Nvidia: Musk says Vera Rubin is 'the best AI computer'
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk is teaming up exclusively with AI leader Nvidia (NVDA) for its AI infrastructure. During SpaceX's first earnings call as a publicly traded company, Musk announced the company will build exclusively on Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin architecture, calling it "the best AI computer."
